title: Decide an evolution-algebra isomorphism by Groebner basis

source.citation: J. M. Casas, M. Ladra, B. A. Omirov, and U. A. Rozikov, On evolution algebras, arXiv:1004.1050

translation.notes: The Mathematica equations for multiplication preservation, natural-basis orthogonality, and invertibility are restated over Q. Their Groebner basis is [1], certifying that the displayed E5 and E6 families are not isomorphic.
